title: Ani Ole Nyɔŋmɔ Jogbaŋŋ?
Ani Obaafo Naagbee Gbii Lɛ?
Okɛ Yehowa Gbɛjianɔtoo Ní Efee Ekome Lɛ Anyiɛ
Nibii Ni Ebɔle Wɔ Ni Tsɔɔ Akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Yɛ
Yelikɛbuamɔ Diɛŋtsɛ Kɛhã Weku Lɛ
Bɔ Ni Nu Afua Ni Ba Yɛ Noa Gbii Lɛ Amli Lɛ Kɔɔ Ohe
Kasemɔ “Tsɛ Ni Mɔbɔnalɛ Eyi Lɛ Obɔ Lɛ”
Feemɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Suɔmɔnaa Nii, Shi Jeee Bo Diɛŋtsɛ Onɔ
Bo Nyɔŋmɔ Wiemɔ Lɛ Toi Jogbaŋŋ Ni Okɛtsu Nii
Ye Anɔkwa Yɛ Owiemɔ Kɛ Onifeemɔi Fɛɛ Mli
‘Wɔfataaa Je Lɛ He’—Ejaa Kɛ Wɔmiikase Kristo
Ani Obuɔ Mɛi Ni Yɔɔ Hegbɛi Yɛ Wɔnɔ Lɛ Tamɔ Bɔ Ni Nyɔŋmɔ Kpaa Gbɛ Lɛ?
Mɛni Ji Nyɔŋmɔ Susumɔ Yɛ Bɔlɛnamɔ Kɛ Gbalashihilɛ He?
Gbɔmɛi Ni He Tse Woɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Hiɛ Nyam
‘Feemɔ Mɛi Fɛɛ Ekpakpa’
Yaa Nɔ Owaje Okɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Teŋ Wekukpãa Lɛ
Okɛ Nɔ Fɛɛ Nɔ Ni Oyɔɔ Lɛ Awo Nyɔŋmɔ Hiɛ Nyam
Okɛ Yehowa Afee Obobaahe
Te Obaafee Tɛŋŋ Ole Nɔ Ni Baaba Onɔ Wɔsɛɛ Lɛ?
Ani Be Eshɛ Ni Nyɔŋmɔ Baaye Je Lɛ Nɔ?
Ohiɛ Asɔ Hegbɛ Ni Onã Akɛ Oji Maŋtsɛyeli Lɛ Mli Nyo Lɛ
Ani Oonã Nibii Ni Yehowa Kɛhãa Wɔ Lɛ Ahe Sɛɛ?
Mɛɛ Yiŋtoo Hewɔ Abɔ Adesai?
Ani Ona ‘Adiagba Ko Ni Jara Wa’?
Wu Oshi Je Lɛ Mumɔ Lɛ!
Ani Ohe Hiaa Nyɔŋmɔ?
Mɛni Hãa Gbãla Sɔɔ?
Jiemɔ Bulɛ Kɛ Suɔmɔ Kpo Yɛ Ogbãla Lɛ Mli
Sɔ̃i Ni Jwere Onɔ Akɛ Fɔlɔ Kɛ Jɔɔmɔi Ni Ekɛbaa
Bɔ Ni Weku Mli Bii Baafee Amɛkɛ Amɛhe Agba Sane Jogbaŋŋ
Ani Onuɔ He Akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ He Miihia Bo?
Bɔ Ni Wɔɔfee Wɔdamɔ Tsuiyeli Naa
Ani Be Ko Baashɛ Ni Abaaye Jalɛ Sane Diɛŋtsɛ?
Ani Abaakadi Bo Kɛhã Yibaamɔ?
Ani Obaanyɛ Ohi Shi Kɛya Naanɔ? Mɛni Baahã Onyɛ Ohi Shi Kɛya Naanɔ?
Ani Abɔ Wɔ Ni Wɔgbolɔ Ni Wɔgboi?
Ani Nyɔŋmɔ Gbɛi Lɛ Anɔ Nyiɛmɔ He Yɛ Sɛɛnamɔ Lɛɛlɛŋ?
Mɛni Esa Akɛ Ofee Koni Abaa Oyi Yɛ Je Lɛ Naagbee Lɛ Mli?
Mɛɛ Gbɛ Nɔ Yesu Kristo Baaye Je Lɛ Nɔ Kunim? Mɛɛ Be Ebaafee Nakai?
Mɛɛ Nibii Etsɛŋ Ebaaba?
“Nyɛdamɔa Shi, Ni Nyɛkwɛa Bɔ Ni Yehowa Baahere Nyɛyiwala Ehã”
Ani Suɔmɔ Baanyɛ Aye Nyɛɛ Nɔ Kunim?
Nibii Ni Nyɔŋmɔ Biɔ Yɛ Wɔdeŋ Lɛ Ahe Yɛ Sɛɛnamɔ Be Fɛɛ Be Baafa
Te Obaafee Tɛŋŋ Onã Yesu Tsɔɔmɔi Lɛ He Sɛɛ?
Nyiɛmɔ Gbɛ Ni Kɛ Mɔ Yaa Naanɔ Wala Mli Lɛ Nɔ
Hiɛmɔ Ohemɔkɛyeli Lɛ Mli Kpɛŋŋ Kɛyashi Naagbee
Hemɔ Sane Kpakpa Lɛ Oye
Kɛ́ Aaka Bo Lɛ, Ye Nyɔŋmɔ Anɔkwa
Ani Abaanyɛ Ahã Shikpɔŋ Lɛ Nɔ Atse?
Bɔ Ni Obaafee Okpɛ Yiŋ Ni Baahã Oye Omanye
Ani Anɔkwale Lɛ Miitsake Bo?
Namɔ Ji O-Nyɔŋmɔ?
Ani Osusumɔi Kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Nɔ Lɛ Kpãa Gbee?
Hemɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Kɛ Eshiwoi Lɛ Oye
Te Obaafee Tɛŋŋ Ofee Gbɛ́i Kpakpa Yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Hiɛ?
Mɛɛ Hiɛnyiɛlɔ Obaanyɛ Okɛ Ohiɛ Afɔ̃ Enɔ?
Wɔhiɛ Ni Wɔɔmia Beni Akɛ Yiwaa Baa Wɔnɔ
Namɛi Ji Kristo Sɛɛnyiɛlɔi Diɛŋtsɛ?
Obaakpa Nɔ Ni Odũɔ
Mɛɛ Oti Okɛma Ohiɛ Yɛ Shihilɛ Mli?
Namɔ Shiwoi Oheɔ Oyeɔ?
Nɛgbɛ Wɔbaanyɛ Wɔná Hiɛnɔkamɔ Kpakpa Yɛ?
Ani Abaanyɛ Ana Anɔkwale Lɛ?
“Shwɛmɔ-Kɛ-Ŋɔɔmɔ” Aloo “Nyɔŋmɔ”—Te Nɔ Ni Obaasumɔ?
Bɔ Ni Ooofee Onã Toinjɔlɛ Yɛ Jeŋ Ni Mlifu Eyi Mli Lɛ Mli
Ani Obaabafata He Ni Atsu Nikpamɔ Nitsumɔ Lɛ?
Jwɛŋmɔ Yehowa Wiemɔ Lɛ Kɛ Nibii Ni Ebɔ Lɛ Anɔ
‘Yaa Nɔ Okɛke Tswaa’
Mɛni Hewɔ Esa Akɛ Oje Suɔmɔ Mli Okɛ Ohe Ashã Afɔlɛ?
Mɛni Hewɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Ji Mɔ Ni Sa Akɛ Okɛ Ohiɛ Afɔ̃ Enɔ?
Mɛni Hewɔ Esa Akɛ ‘Oya Nɔ Oshi Kpe’? Te Obaafee Tɛŋŋ Ofee Nakai?
Suɔmɔ Ji Nɔ Ni Kadiɔ Anɔkwa Kristofoi Asafo Lɛ
Bɔ Ni Obaafee Onã “Tsui Ni Hiɛ Kã Shi”
Yehowa Miikwɛ Wɔ
Ani Bɔ Ni Ohiɔ Shi Ohãa Lɛ Tsɔɔ Akɛ Ofiɔ Yehowa Nɔyeli Lɛ Sɛɛ?
Biblia Mli Shishitoo Mlai—Ani Amɛbaanyɛ Amɛwa Wɔ Kɛdamɔ Naagbai Ni Wɔkɛkpeɔ Ŋmɛnɛ Lɛ Anaa?
“Nyɛkɔa Gbɔfeemɔ Gbɛ Lɛ”
Okɛ Miishɛɛ Tsui Asɔmɔ Yehowa
Namɔ Okɛbaabɔ Naanyo?
Ani Okɛ Ohiɛ Fɔ̃ɔ Jeŋ Shikpamɔ Nɔ Aloo Biblia Lɛ Nɔ?
Namɛi Sa Akɛ Amɛfeɔ Mɛi Yesu Kaselɔi?
Yehowa Kɛ Kristo—Ani Amɛji Triniti Ko Fã?
Ani Esa Akɛ Kristofoi Aye Kitãi Nyɔŋma Lɛ Nɔ?
Ani Obaaje Nɔ Ni Baaba Je Nɛɛ Nɔ Lɛ Mli?
Sanekpakpa Ni Ashiɛɔ Yɛ Yiwalɛ Jeŋ Mli
Sɔlemɔi Ni Nyɔŋmɔ Boɔ Toi
Mɛɛ Wekukpaa Kã Okɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Teŋ?
Mɛni Hewɔ Esa Akɛ Ohi Shi Yɛ Biblia Mli Gbɛtsɔɔmɔi Lɛ Anaa?
Ani Anɔkwale Lɛ He Kumai Miiye Bo? Ba!
Feemɔ Bɔ Fɛɛ Bɔ Ni Obaanyɛ Koni Onine Ashɛ Wala Diɛŋtsɛ Lɛ Nɔ!
Ba Ni Mesia Lɛ Eba Lɛ Kɛ Enɔyeli Lɛ
Gbɛfaŋnɔ Ni Nyɔŋmɔ Jamɔ Ená Yɛ Je Lɛŋ Saji Amli
Ani Adebɔɔ Naa Oshãrai Asɛɛ Baafo?
Anɔkwa Jamɔ Tsuɔ Adesai Ashihilɛ Mli Hiamɔ Nii Ahe Nii
Kaahã Daimonioi Lɛ Laka Bo!
Mɛni Baaba Jamɔi Anɔ Wɔsɛɛ?
Ní Aaahi Shi Akɛ Mɔ Ni Shwamɔ Ko Bɛ Ehe Yɛ Yinɔ Kɔ̃ɔdɔŋ Mli
“Je Nɛŋ Nifeemɔ Lɛ Miitsake”
Nɔ Hewɔ Ni Obaanyɛ Ohe Saji Ni Yɔɔ Biblia Lɛ Mli Lɛ Oye
Bɔ Ni Obaafee Onã Nanemɛi Kpakpai Ni Okɛ Amɛ Abɔ Daa
Yehowa—‘Bɔlɔ Kpele Lɛ’
Okɛ Ojwɛŋmɔ Ama “Gbalɛ Wiemɔ Lɛ” Nɔ
Obaanyɛ Onã Miishɛɛ Yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔɔmɔ Mli
Fɔlɔi—Ani Nyɛkɛ Nibii Ni La Nyɛŋ Ashã Lɛ Miitsu Nii?
Ní Wɔɔná Miishɛjemɔ Yɛ Wɔ Amanehului Lɛ Fɛɛ Sɛɛ
Shikpɔŋ Lɛ Fitemɔ Kɛ Ŋwei Toigbalamɔ Baa
Ani Otsɔse Ohenilee Lɛ? Ani Oonã He Sɛɛ?
Kaashe Gbeyei, Nibii Baahi Wɔsɛɛ!
Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli Lɛ Ebɛŋkɛ
Nyɔŋmɔ Baa Klɛŋklɛŋ Yɛ Weku Shihilɛ Ni Yeɔ Omanye Mli
Mɛɛ Gbɛ Nɔ Abaatsɔ Atsa Adesai Kwraa?
Te Obaafee Tɛŋŋ Ojie Suɔmɔ Kpo Yɛ Jeŋ Ni Asusuu Mɔ He Lɛ Mli?
Mɛni Oblahii Kɛ Oblayei Baanyɛ Afee Koni Amɛye Omanye Ni Amɛná Miishɛɛ?
Hiɛsɔɔ Ni Aaaná Aha Nyɔŋmɔ Adebɔɔ Nibii Ni Yɔɔ Naakpɛɛ Lɛ
Kaahã Satan Ŋaatsɔi Lɛ Eko Kwraa Du Bo
Okɛ Nilee Ahala Onanemɛi!
Bɔ Ni Ooofee Ni Okɛ Ekpakpafeemɔ Aye Efɔŋ Nɔ Kunim
Oblahii Kɛ Oblayei Bibii Ni Aaakwɛ Amɛ Yɛ Bɔ Ni Yehowa Kwɛɔ Amɛ Ehaa Lɛ Naa
Je Lɛ Ni Kristofoi Tsiɔ Amɛhe Kɛjeɔ He—Nɔ Hewɔ Ni Ehe Yɔɔ Sɛɛnamɔ
Nɔ Hewɔ Ni Esa Akɛ Aba He Shi Aha Nyɔŋmɔ Nɔyeli Bianɛ
Namɛi Abaahere Amɛyiwala Be Ni Akpãtãa Jeŋ Fɔŋ Nɛɛ Hiɛ Lɛ?
Jeŋ Muu Fɛɛ Toinjɔlɛ—Kɛjɛ Nɛgbɛ?
Nɔ Hewɔ Ni Esa Akɛ Kristofoi Afee Srɔto
Nɔ Ni Abaadamɔ Nɔ Aná Hekɛnɔfɔɔ Akɛ Ŋwei Aje Aŋma Biblia Lɛ
Nɔ Hewɔ Ní Kpɔmɔnɔ He Hiaa Adesai
Namɔ Abaanyɛ Ahere Eyiwala?
Mɛni Baa Wɔnɔ Kɛ́ Wɔgboi?
Ani Hɛl Ji He Ko Ni Akɛ La Piŋɔ Mɔ Yɛ Lɛɛlɛŋ?
Ani Triniti Tsɔɔmɔ Lɛ Yɛ Biblia Lɛ Mli?
Shikpɔŋ Lɛ Baahi Shi Kɛya Naanɔ
Tsĩi Abonsam Gbɛ!
Gbohiiashitee Lɛ—Eji Gbele Nɔ Kunimyeli!
Adesai Ashishijee Lɛ—Ani Nɔ Ni Oheɔ Oyeɔ Lɛ Kɔɔ He Eko?
Ani Esa Akɛ Kristofoi Aye Hejɔɔmɔ Gbi Lɛ?
Krɔŋkrɔŋ Ní Wala Kɛ Lá Ji
Ani Nyɔŋmɔ Kpɛlɛɔ Amagai Ni Akɛtsuɔ Nii Yɛ Jamɔ Mli Lɛ Nɔ?
Ani Biblia Lɛ Mli Naakpɛɛ Nii Lɛ Ba Mli Lɛɛlɛŋ?
Okɛ Jwɛŋmɔ Kpakpa Ahi Shi Yɛ Jeŋ Ni Efite Mli
Nyɔŋmɔ He Nilee Ni Yɔɔ Jeŋ Nilee Jeŋ Ko Mli
Namɔ Tuuntu Ji Yesu Kristo?
Ŋtsɔi Ni Adesai Dɔmɔɔ—Mɛɛ Be Ebaaba Naagbee?
Nɔ Hewɔ Ni Esa Akɛ Oyaba Yehowa Abo
Okɛ Ohiɛ Afɔ̃ Miishɛjemɔ Fɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Lɛ Nɔ
Asafo Ní Yeɔ Anɔkwa Yɛ Kristo Hiɛnyiɛmɔ Shishi
Namɔ Tamɔ Yehowa, Wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ Lɛ?
Okɛ Wolokasemɔ Atsu Nii Ní Okɛjie Yehowa Yi
Hemɔ Oye Akɛ Yehowa Ji Mɔ Ni Yɔɔ Hewalɛ Ni Ebaanyɛ Ekɛhere Wɔyiwala
Ani Okɛ Bɔ Ni Nyɔŋmɔ Buɔ Wala Ehaa Lɛ Kpãa Gbee?
Ani Okɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Miinyiɛ?
Ani Je Nɛɛ Hiɛ Baakpãtã?
Yehowa Ji ‘Mɔɔ Ní Wa’ Kɛha Ewebii
Harmagedon Diɛŋtsɛ Lɛ—Mɛni Hewɔ? Mɛɛ Bɛ?
Nyɛhãa ‘Gbi Ni Yɔɔ Gbeyei’ Lɛ Ahia Nyɛjwɛŋmɔ Mli!
Adesa Nɔyeli—Áŋmɛ Yɛ Ŋsɛni Mli
Ani Babilon Kojomɔ Ŋmɛlɛtswaa Lɛ Eshɛ?
Kojomɔ Gbi—Be Kɛha Gbeyeishemɔ Aloo Hiɛnɔkamɔ?
Bɔ Ni Anɔkwa Kristofoi Wulaa Nibii Ni Yehowa Tsɔɔ Amɛ Lɛ
Feemɔ Ekãa, Ni Okɛ Ohiɛ Afɔ̃ Yehowa Nɔ
Aaaná Shweshweeshwe Shihilɛ Yɛ Jeŋ Ko Ni Oshara Yɔɔ Mli Lɛ Mli
Baamɔ Nɔ Ni Kadiɔ Bo Akɛ Kristofonyo Lɛ Yi!
Mɛni Hewɔ Yesu Na Amanehulu Ni Egbo?
Kpɔmɔ Kɛmiijɛ Jeŋ Ni Mli Ewo Duŋ Mli
Mɛni Hewɔ Esa Akɛ Ashe Anɔkwa Nyɔŋmɔ Lɛ Gbeyei?
Ani Nyɔŋmɔ Kã He Eeye Nɔ?
Namɔ Jeŋba He Mlai Onyaa He?
Mɛni Ji Anɔkwa Hemɔkɛyeli? Ni Te Ajieɔ Lɛ Kpo Ahãa Tɛŋŋ?
Feemɔ Onii Yɛ Nilee Mli Yɛ Jeŋ Ni Efeee Enii Yɛ Nilee Mli Nɛɛ Mli
Obaanyɛ Onu He Akɛ Oyɛ Shweshweeshwe Yɛ Jeŋ Ni Haomɔ Yɔɔ Mli Nɛɛ Mli!
Mɛni Hewɔ Esa Akɛ Oha Biblia Lɛ Atsɔɔ Bo Gbɛ?
Namɔ Sa Jogbaŋŋ Akɛ Eyeɔ Adesai Anɔ?
Obaanyɛ Ohi Shi Yɛ Toinjɔlɛ Mli Bianɛ—Kɛ Agbɛnɛ Kɛmiiya Naanɔ!
Te Nyɔŋmɔ Naa Bo Ehãa Tɛŋŋ?
Ani Nyɔŋmɔ Kpɛlɛɔ Jamɔi Fɛɛ Anɔ?
Namɛi Baaná Nyɔŋmɔ Jeŋ Hee Lɛ Mli Gbɛ?
Mɛni Tsɔɔ Akɛ Biblia Lɛ Ja?
Anɔkwa Toinjɔlɛ Kɛ Shweshweeshwe Shihilɛ—Mɛɛ Be Ebaaba?
Nɛgbɛ Abaanyɛ Aná Yelikɛbuamɔ Kɛjɛ Yɛ Haomɔ Beaŋ?
Bá Ojeŋ Yɛ Emuuyeli Mli
Kwa Je Lɛŋ Yaka Yiŋsusumɔi Lɛ, Dii Maŋtsɛyeli Lɛ He Nibii Ni Yɔɔ Diɛŋtsɛ Lɛ Asɛɛ
Nɔ Hewɔ Ni Esa Akɛ Gbohiiashitee He Hiɛnɔkamɔ Lɛ Afee Nɔ Ni Yɔɔ Diɛŋtsɛ Kɛha Bo
Ani Ebɛŋkɛ Fe Bɔ Ni Osusuɔ?
Nɔ Ni Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli Lɛ Miifee Eehã Wɔ Bianɛ
Kaakwɛ Nibii Gbohii!
Ani Gbele Kɛ Nɔ Fɛɛ Nɔ Baa Naagbee?
Ani Anɔkwale Lɛ Miiná Onɔ Hewalɛ?
Baafata Nyɔŋmɔ Webii Ni Yɔɔ Miishɛɛ Lɛ Ahe
Mɛni Hewɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Ni Yɔɔ Suɔmɔ Lɛ Ŋmɛɔ Efɔŋfeemɔ Gbɛ?
Ani Okɛ Ohiɛ Fɔ̃ɔ Yehowa Nɔ?
Okɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Anyiɛ Koni Onã Jɔɔmɔi Amrɔ Nɛɛ Kɛ Naanɔi Fɛɛ
Oweku Lɛ Baanyɛ Aná Miishɛɛ Ni Hi Kɛwula Shi
Bɔ Ni Suɔmɔ Kɛ Hemɔkɛyeli Yeɔ Je Lɛ Nɔ Kunim
Ani Onyiɛ Gbɛ Ni Kɛ Mɔ Yaa Naanɔ Wala Mli Lɛ Nɔ?
Abaahere Wɔ Kɛjɛ Jeŋ Ni Haomɔ Yɔɔ Mli Nɛɛ Mli
Bɔ Ni Hiɛshikamɔ Ni Jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Ŋɔɔ Lɛ Yeɔ Ebuaa Wɔ
